\caption{\bt{Accuracy (\%) of the user agent by data change, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, five independent runs per method (\ScenCells\ runs, \ScenValidTasks\ scored tasks, \ScenAgentHours\ agent-hours). Rows follow the sets of Table~\ref{tab:ladder}, each with its colour in the other figures. A cell gives the accuracy pooled over the runs, the range of the five runs below it, and a shade by accuracy; a dark red frame marks a setting in which at least 25\% of the tasks used a stale definition, i.e., one whose generated SQL answers that setting's questions incorrectly. The covered breaks target key uniqueness (status rows, restated sales, duplicate load), join cardinality (SCD Type 2), and date-key completeness (date-key format). Right: accuracy over all covered breaks with its 95\% bootstrap interval over runs, and definitions invalidated and repairs published per run.}{按数据变化划分的用户端智能体正确率（\%），DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，每种方法 5 次独立运行（共 \ScenCells\ 次运行、\ScenValidTasks\ 道计分题、\ScenAgentHours\ 智能体小时）。各行按表~\ref{tab:ladder} 分组，行首色块为该方法在其他图中的颜色。每格给出 5 次运行合并的正确率，其下为 5 次运行的范围，底色深浅表示正确率；深红框表示该情形下至少 25\% 的题使用了过期定义，即其生成的 SQL 在该情形下答错的定义。条件覆盖的破坏分别针对键唯一性（状态流水、更正保留旧行、重复加载）、连接基数（缓慢变化维）和日期键完整性（日期键格式）。右侧：全部覆盖的破坏上的正确率及按运行重抽样的 95\% 区间，以及每次运行失效的定义数与发布的修复数。}}
\label{fig:scenarios}
\Description{A result matrix with nine method rows in four sets and twelve setting columns grouped as no change (held-out), non-breaking updates (append, late arriving, in-place fix, new column), breaks covered by a condition (status rows, restated sales, duplicate load, SCD Type 2, date-key format), and outside the guarantee (unit change, backup copy), followed by a block with accuracy over all covered breaks and per-run invalidations and repairs. Cells are shaded from white to navy by accuracy. No memory answers 7 to 60 percent and 32 over the covered breaks. Every sharing method answers 98 to 100 on held-out questions. MAVRA, outlined in navy, answers 100 on held-out, status rows, restated sales, and SCD Type 2, 52 under duplicate loads and 7 under the date-key format, 72 over all covered breaks (interval 70 to 73), with 23.6 invalidations and 9.2 repairs per run. Example retrieval answers 64, 83, and 35 under status rows, restated sales, and duplicate loads, 59 over the covered breaks; with self-verification 63. Invalidation on schema change has red frames on all five covered breaks and reaches 60; invalidation on every write 65 with 40.2 invalidations per run; the full recheck per definition 71. The regression variants reach 66 on current data and 72 with the gold-SQL reference. Unit change and backup copy stay between 27 and 86 for all methods, with red frames on the unit change for every method that keeps definitions across writes.}
